title: Material Test Tool in LightBurn | Setup Guide
body_html:
Material Test Tool

LightBurn provides a material testing function. You can perform a material test before processing a specific material to achieve the parameters you want.

Please refer to this video:

Lightburn Material Test Card | OneLaser XRF Desktop

If you don’t want to create the parameter test file yourself, you can also download the test file we have prepared.

Please note that due to ongoing LightBurn version updates, there may be file mismatches or loss of details.
